doc.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997

title: Introduction and Piano Jazz borrowed intro
summary: Monk Rowe introduces McPartland, borrowing her Piano Jazz style, and asks about the radio show.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My guest today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive interviews is Marian McPartland, highly regarded pianist, author, radio personality, composer — and welcome. You look wonderful.
I’m so glad to have you here.
It’s nice to be here but I get nervous when I hear all those things being, that laundry list of things—
Well you’ve earned them and I don’t know if you noticed I kind of borrowed your introduction from “Piano Jazz.”
I listened to a few today.
Oh, you did, well they must be all right then because sometimes I have quite a job, I mean depending on who it is. But it’s kind of fun making up something to introduce the guest with.
Can we talk about that for a moment?
